versions.content: Local BSW data without RTE or BSW Scheduler support In many cases such data in the context of a module (or cluster) do not need any support by the RTE resp. BSW Scheduler. They are simply allocated by the module's code but they still may be accessed from outside of the module for measurement, calibration or as NvM mirrors. These data are described by the following roles: • BswInternalBehavior . staticMemory for variable data • BswInternalBehavior . constantMemory for constant data
